property-development.q: Can you help assess a development opportunity?
property-development.a: Yes. We can review site constraints, planning potential, access, likely construction route, specification, programme pressure and broad viability so clients can make better early decisions.

property-development.q: Do you work on joint venture development projects?
property-development.a: Yes. We can support suitable joint venture opportunities where the site, planning strategy, funding route and delivery structure are aligned from the outset.

property-development.q: Can you manage development from concept to completion?
property-development.a: Yes. We can coordinate acquisition input, planning support, consultants, design development, construction delivery, handover and long-term property enhancement through one joined-up team.

property-development.q: What type of development schemes do you focus on?
property-development.a: We focus on residential, commercial and mixed-use opportunities, including apartments, urban housing, student accommodation, HMOs, refurbishment-led value creation and new-build schemes.

property-development.q: Can you coordinate planning and building control?
property-development.a: We can coordinate with architects, engineers, planning consultants, building control and other appointed specialists so development, construction and inspection requirements are aligned.

property-development.q: Do you help before drawings are final?
property-development.a: Yes. Early input can help identify planning, buildability, sequencing, specification and cost pressures before work starts on site.
Structural design remains with the appointed engineer, while we coordinate the development route, construction sequence and practical site requirements around their information.

property-development.q: How early should we involve you?
property-development.a: The earlier the better. Development and pre-construction input can reduce surprises around planning, cost, sequencing, access and specification.

property-development.q: How long will my project take?
property-development.a: Programme depends on scope, approvals, lead times, structural complexity and site constraints. We set out realistic timing during proposal stage.
Where the scope and supply chain allow it, we can prioritise enabling works, phased procurement and focused delivery milestones.

construction.q: What construction projects do you take on?
construction.a: We deliver new builds, residential refurbishments, commercial refurbishments, basements, extensions, vertical extensions, loft conversions, mixed-use schemes, listed buildings and complex conversions.

construction.q: Do you provide design and build services?
construction.a: Yes. We can coordinate design, consultants, specification, pricing and construction delivery under one managed route, giving clients one accountable team.

construction.q: Can you manage complex structural works?
construction.a: Yes, where supported by suitable structural design. We coordinate temporary works, sequencing, specialist packages and practical site requirements.

construction.q: Can you work with developers, lenders and professional teams?
construction.a: Yes. We regularly work with developers, investors, asset managers, consultants, funders and private clients where programme control and delivery confidence matter.

construction.q: Can you work on listed or sensitive buildings?
construction.a: Yes. These projects need tighter control around existing fabric, approvals, sequencing, protection and specialist trades.

construction.q: Can works be phased around occupied properties?
construction.a: Where feasible, yes. We plan access, temporary protection, noisy works and service interruptions with the client and design team.

construction.q: Do you handle commercial fit-out and refurbishment?
construction.a: Yes. We deliver commercial refurbishment, fit-out, structural alterations, finishing packages, property services and maintenance-related works.

construction.q: Can you reduce disruption to trading or tenants?
construction.a: We can plan phasing, access, logistics and working hours to reduce disruption where the building remains live or partially occupied.

construction.q: Do you deliver CAT A and CAT B style works?
construction.a: Yes. We can support landlord-ready shell works and more detailed occupier fit-out scopes, depending on specification and drawings.

construction.q: What residential projects do you take on?
construction.a: We work across property development, basements, extensions, vertical extensions, loft conversions, refurbishments, new builds, HMO conversions, high-spec fit-outs and long-term property enhancement.

construction.q: Can you work with private clients and developers?
construction.a: Yes. We can support private homeowners, developers, investors, portfolio owners and professional teams where quality, programme and coordination matter.

construction.q: Can you help improve layouts and finishes?
construction.a: We can contribute practical buildability and finish sequencing advice alongside the architect, designer or client specification.

construction.q: Can you manage the full property project process?
construction.a: Yes. We can manage planning support, design coordination, site setup, programming, procurement, subcontractors, quality checks, client updates and handover documentation.

construction.q: How do you keep clients informed?
construction.a: We agree the communication rhythm early, then provide clear updates around progress, decisions, risks, programme and next actions.

property-services.q: What do your Property Services cover?
property-services.a: Property Services covers pre-construction support, groundworks, structural works, interiors, kitchen and bathroom fit-out, plumbing, HVAC, electrical, security, data, smart systems, landscaping, maintenance and aftercare.

property-services.q: Can you handle planned and reactive maintenance?
property-services.a: Yes. We can support planned preventative maintenance and reactive repair works for residential, commercial and mixed-use assets, helping properties remain compliant, safe and operational.

property-services.q: Do you provide smaller works as well as major projects?
property-services.a: Yes. Property Services can support smaller refurbishments, extensions, conversions, repair works, fit-out packages and upgrades where a specialist team is the right route.

property-services.q: Can you support smart building and technical systems?
property-services.a: Yes. We can coordinate smart building integration, electrical systems, security, access control, data, fibre, ICT infrastructure and ongoing technical aftercare.
Our core coverage is London and the Home Counties, with each opportunity reviewed against scope, logistics and programme requirements.

property-services.q: Can you review projects beyond the core coverage area?
property-services.a: Sometimes. If the scope is a strong fit and the logistics make sense, we can review projects beyond the core London and Home Counties area.
For most meaningful scopes, a site visit or detailed information review is needed before a reliable proposal can be prepared.
We review drawings, schedules, site constraints and specification details before preparing a written proposal or budget guidance.
Yes. Project scope, exclusions, assumptions, price and programme are confirmed in writing before works proceed.

property-services.q: Can you work from a budget?
property-services.a: Yes. A realistic budget helps guide specification choices, phasing and value decisions before the project is fixed.
